A university research project, not a government body.

facts.fact: The University of Cabo Verde says its EU and AU-funded project tests wireless sensor networks and IoT and AI water management systems for agriculture, in year four of five.
The University of Cabo Verde says it is building IoT and AI water-management systems in the SSWAxC4V project and runs RS2Lab, an IoT and AI laboratory inaugurated in November 2023.
